name: spymonk-redact-web
description: SpyMonk Redact browser playground: redaction runs locally in a WebAssembly worker.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.build: node scripts/build-wasm.mjs && npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs
